content.address:
If UGREENlink remote access service is enabled on the device, please enter UGREENlink ID. This service is recommended for accessing your device anytime, anywhere
Other connection methods:
① LAN IP connection
IP address + HTTP port number (e.g., 192.168.1.1:9999)
② Secure LAN IP connection
HTTPS + device IP address + HTTPS port number (e.g., https://192.168.1.1:9443)
③ LAN custom domain connection
Customize domain prefix + HTTP(S) port number (e.g., http://demo.local:9999 or https://demo.local:9443). Requires Android 12.0 or above. Not supported on HarmonyOS
④ Public IP (or domain pointing to public IP) connection
Public IP + port forwarding port number, or full domain address
⑤ DDNS domain
If a valid DDNS is configured on the device, enter the full DDNS domain address
content.connection:
1. Please check your phone's network signal and make sure the UGREEN NAS is powered on. Newly started devices may take 3–5 minutes to connect while services are initializing
2. Please ensure your phone and the UGREEN NAS are on the same network for LAN IP connections. Use the icon next to the address field to search for devices on your LAN. (If your mobile OS supports "Local Network" permission controls, please ensure the UGREEN NAS app has been granted this permission)
3. Please verify that the UGREENlink ID is correct and that the "UGREENlink remote access" service is enabled
4. If the connection still fails after the above checks, please refer to the "Device Address Guide" to check your input
content.localAccount:
1. UGREEN NAS: Accounts are created and stored on the device by the admin. Contact the admin for sign-in credentials
2. HomeAgent: Local accounts allow offline access via the local network. Enable under "Settings > User Management > Edit user > Local account" first
content.ipBlocked:
This IP address has been blocked because the maximum allowed number of failed sign-in attempts within the specified period has been reached
1. You can sign in from another unblocked IP address, such as a different computer or mobile device
2. To unblock the IP address:
(1) If your UGREEN NAS device has multiple admins, please contact one of them with system access to unblock your IP address. (Path: Control Panel > Security > Block management > Blocked IP list)
(2) If you are the only admin for this UGREEN NAS device, press and hold the device’s RESET button for 5 seconds until you hear a beep then release it. Once the device restarts, all blocked IP addresses will be unblocked
content.otp:
Applicable only to NAS devices that support two‑factor authentication (excluding HomeAgent series)
1. Please confirm your verification code is correct, or sync the system time between your mobile device and the UGREEN NAS device. Automatic time settings are recommended on both ends. Changing NTP settings while 2FA is enabled may invalidate OTP codes
2. To disable 2FA:
(1) If you have a trusted device, sign in to the device and disable 2FA
(2) If your UGREEN NAS has multiple admins, please contact one of them with system access to disable 2FA for your account. (Path: Control Panel > User Management > User > Edit User)
(3) If you are the only admin, press and hold the RESET button for 5 seconds until you hear a beep, then release it. Once the device restarts, sign in to your NAS device with the credentials (Username: admin. Password is blank) to reset your account. Once reset, 2FA will be disabled, and you can sign in with your new credentials

userAgree.title: Пользовательское соглашение
userAgree.sectionTitle: Dear user, thank you for trusting and using UGREEN NAS
userAgree.desc1: According to the provisions on the scope of necessary personal information for common types of mobile internet apps, the client does not belong to any of them, and its basic function services are "To provide basic file management services, and users can upload, download, and back up files anytime and anywhere after binding to the UGREEN NAS device". You need to use the mobile phone number to log in. After logging in and binding the device, you can use function services.
userAgree.desc2: The basic service functions of the APP include: After the UGREEN NAS device is bound, files can be uploaded, downloaded, backed up, and viewed. The necessary personal information involved in basic service functions is: mobile phone number.
userAgree.desc3: We take personal information and privacy protection seriously. To deliver better services, we may need to collect certain personal information or obtain necessary permissions. Please be assured that we will provide adequate security measures in strict accordance with applicable laws. For more details on permissions, please refer to the following files

guideStep.stepMsg3Desc: You can change in "Control Panel > Update & Restore > Update Settings" later.

displayList.desc1: All account data, including the admin account created during initialization and users added in "Control Panel", is stored locally on the device. Usernames and passwords are verified on the NAS device upon sign-in
displayList.desc2: You can find and connect your NAS device anytime, anywhere by enabling UGREENlink. Note: The UGREENlink can only help you connect to the device, and you need to verify your local account and password first.
displayList.desc3: In "Storage", you can manage storage pools and volumes, view hard drive status, create health test plans and more
displayList.desc4: Storage pool is the starting point for all storage. We need to combine hard disks to form a "pool". It is important to choose an appropriate way to form an pool in the process. RAID 1 mode is safer, but with less available capacity.
displayList.desc5: A storage pool is like a warehouse; a volume is its shelving. When creating a volume, choose a file system. Just as shelves suit different goods, file systems have distinct characteristics
displayList.desc6: Folders are required to access files easily. You can set different permission rules to limit access/read/write to shared folder .
displayList.desc7: Many apps use personal folder as the basic data source. For example, photos under "Personal folder/Photos" will appear in personal library of "Photos". Personal library is not available if personal folder is not enabled. (Please go to "Control Panel > User management" > Edit user to enable personal folder)
displayList.desc8: In "Control Panel > User management", we can manage "User" and "User group". Two roles for users: administrator and general user. Administrator can manage users and devices while general users can only use features.
displayList.desc9: In App Center, we can download and install apps. Besides, new features and third party apps will be available here. We can update all installed apps or uninstall apps that are no longer needed.
displayList.desc10: There are three models in "Photos": "Library", "Albums" and "Tools". Photos stored in a specific folder will be in the "Library". We can select some photos from the  "Library" to create an "Album". Tools such as similar photo recognition are provided in "Tools"
